question: Does a single conditionally gated recurrent instruction model improve complete, source-grounded human explanations and varied ordinary assistance while retaining all previous comparisons against untouched Base?
protocol: One direct native comparison only after successful execution-contrastive and whole-response fitting. Freeze all 340 real openings, order, declarations, greedy free thinking, three turns of 384 tokens, same physical machine and scoring for both. Compare the deployed fixed recurrent policy with original ordinary-depth BF16 Qwen Base. Add 24 untouched FeTaQA pages, each shown inline and through a mounted database, and 24 original never evaluated human-written instructions, three from each of eight categories. Preserve relative order, exact inputs and scorers of the 268 older cases. Require all previously registered automatic and masked gates on those 268, strict reductions on all five registered latency/rate/memory quantities on the full 340, no lower new-family completion, and more mounted reads. Grade all 156 prespecified visible pairs, with arm identities and aggregates sealed until the project reviewer commits grades, preferences and reasons. On FeTaQA require at least six whole fully usable pairs, net at least five, source-paired two-sided p<=.05, positive net in both views, no individual Base success lost and no increase in unsupported replies. Grounded mounted success requires an untruncated observed query with at least two distinct source-attested values as well as a fully usable visible answer. Separate lexical source coverage and human quality. On the fresh open instructions require six net preferences, strictly more fully usable replies, no individual fully usable Base response lost and no increase in unsupported replies. References may be stale or contain errors. Record every individual transition and every physical cost together. A failed fit closes this primary. A failed primary closes its depth attribution, seed and full context descendants. A joint pass unlocks first an independent training seed then equally exposed K1 using the same instruction sibling, quantization, parameter count and source order, then installation and actual >131072-token changed-source qualification. No inference-time expert selection, deterministic answer production, reranking, execution oracle or injected support labels.
